name: manual_073044
claim: Never patch a live script ahead of its source: reproduce with a fake that behaves like the real platform, write the failing test, change the canonical source, and only then paste. Where a project keeps two implementations, change the source language first, then its translation and sync map, and run parity. Run the privacy scanner before any publish. A live-only edit has no twin and the next sync deletes it.
